description: Tiny public-safe synthetic fixture for deterministic fixture-only quality-check scaffolding. This fixture does not use provider calls, model inference, semantic judging, human review results, H100/GPU/CUDA/server/remote execution, production data, or private data.

items.input: Synthetic support ticket: user asks how to reset a password after an expired link.
items.acceptance_criteria: The fixture-only deterministic label must exactly match the expected public-safe label.

items.input: Synthetic validation task: normalized ticket object should include id, route, and priority fields.
items.acceptance_criteria: The observed public-safe object must include every expected field.

items.input: Synthetic routing explanation: route a billing FAQ request to a reusable deterministic answer.
items.acceptance_criteria: The normalized public-safe structure must match after object-key ordering and list ordering are normalized.

items.input: Synthetic document intake task: classify a public-safe invoice stub.
items.acceptance_criteria: The fixture-only deterministic document type must exactly match.

items.input: Synthetic open-ended planning request that lacks a public-safe expected output.
items.skip_reason: No public-safe expected output is present for deterministic fixture-only checking.
items.acceptance_criteria: Skipped items must be counted separately and must not be treated as checked results.

items.input: Synthetic response-quality item that would require semantic or human review in a later approved goal.
items.gate_reason: Semantic or human review remains separately approval-gated and is not executed by this scaffold.
items.acceptance_criteria: Gated items must be counted separately and must not be treated as deterministic checks.
